title: Foundry Slag
description: A mid-register bass built entirely from a mangled 'metal' dirt sample: chopped into grains and pitched far down with negative speed so it grinds like molten slag pouring through a band-pass. Over 16 cycles the chop count, downward speed, crush bits and distortion all drift, degrading a clean metallic clang into a corroded, sputtering low growl.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  s("metal*2").n("<0 2 1 3>/2")
    .chop("<8 16 12 24>/4")
    .speed("<0.18 0.14 0.22 0.12>/2").shape(sine.slow(16).range(0.25, 0.55))
    .bpf(sine.slow(13).range(180, 1400)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(8, 18)).bpenv("<2 4 3 5>/8")
    .crush("<14 8 6 9>/8").distort(saw.slow(24).range(0.2, 0.7)).coarse("<1 2 1 4>/4")
    .attack(0.004).release(0.08)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-0.16).crush(5))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(-12)).gain(0.3).chop(6).bpf(320))
    .delay("0.35:0.1875:0.5").room(0.22).gain(0.95)
)
